title: Quick Syrian Shrimp Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. This recipe combines succulent prawns with the bold flavors of the Middle East.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Middle Eastern spice blend, lemon juice, and garlic.
3. Add prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
5. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until prawns are pink and cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
